method: Actual localhost main page in Codex in-app browser; inline screenshots, DOM accessibility and read-only production diagnostics. Intentional failRoom/failStartup flags distinguished from actual loading errors.

checks.check: desktop, portrait and short landscape logo/background/error layout
checks.details: Logo, status and retry fit with no clipping; tested on explicit failRoom path, not a real resource failure.
Explicit motion=reduce: browser computed halo, sheen, orbit carrier animationName=none and trace transitionDuration=0s.

checks.check: production controller / real weighted progress CPU regression
checks.details: Actual source callbacks, real GSAP and Three hierarchy; layout/image decode are explicit test substitutes.

checks.check: mobile and desktop successful real loading and welcome
checks.details: Observed real 45% room stage with luminous orbit tracing, then all four stages ready at 100%, loader hidden and terminal welcome visible; logo fits at 52px desktop / 44px mobile.
Two initial downward scrolls produced startCount=1 and completeCount=1; controls restored, errors=[].

checks.check: mobile keyboard entry and resize during room opening
checks.details: Return from 390x844 welcome, changed to1280x720 during opening, completed exactly once with controls restored and errors=[].
Intentional failStartup=gallery stayed60%, ready=false, entered=false; retry removed the failure flag and returned to100% ready terminal welcome with errors=[].

checks.check: night logo legibility and continuous clock blend
checks.details: Actual night screenshot shows light-on-dark silhouette; mid-transition computed overlay opacity .249031 at dayMix .61590037. No discrete day/night icon toggle.

limitations: CPU tests use explicit layout and texture-decode substitutes; browser checks are separately recorded.
Mobile viewport and keyboard were tested; physical touch hardware was not exercised.
No frame-rate guarantee or new user visual approval is implied.
